pkgmetadata.longdescription: Stasis is a context-aware, event-driven Wayland idle manager written in Rust. It supports sequential configurable timeouts, media-aware idle handling, application-specific inhibitors, the Wayland idle-inhibit protocol, session D-Bus inhibit traffic, and manual inhibition via CLI or a StatusNotifier tray frontend.

use.flag: Enable media/call detection via pactl from media-sound/pulseaudio-utils
